title: Golf Range Inc - Incremental game just passed 600 Android downloads!
author: OiaOrca
selftext:
Hey! I released my incremental game about driving around a golf picker about 15 days ago. So far, it has just passed 600 installs on android, and several hundred players in the browser version!

Play store link: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.golfrangeinc.game&hl=en\\\_US](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.golfrangeinc.game&hl=en%5C_US)  
Web link:[http://golfrangeinc.com](http://golfrangeinc.com)  
I’m planning on an iOS and potentially a steam release in the future also.

Would love if you’d give it a try, and share some honest feedback!

More backstory of the idea: I live in New Orleans and there’s a driving range here called Five o Fore. The skyline is great, and I felt like it made a perfect setting for a mobile game, so I started prototyping! I settled on an incremental game about driving a golf cart picker and expanding the range, and recreated roughly the same skyline that the real place has (with some small differences so the skyline looks balanced). 

Feedback so far has been really solid. Several players already have 20+ hours played, which is mind boggling.

More about my workflow: it’s entirely just Claude code and some manual coding with manual 3D modeling. I work very iteratively, as in I don’t do any big passes or “one shots” ever. I feel this gives me much more control over the result.

To where it’s at now has been 3 months of development. If you have any more questions about my process, let me know!
